bio: I'm a computer science student at Champlain College Saint-Lambert, and I've always needed to know how things work. Engines, electronics, software: I take them apart, figure them out, and build them back up.

Most of what I know, I learned hands-on: a summer as an automotive mechanic intern, fixing up go-karts, running a homelab on a Raspberry Pi, and building games and this website. Off the keyboard, I coach judo and play soccer.
